grading.title: Grading scheme
grading.description: How grades are displayed across report cards and gradebooks school-wide.

grading.help: Changes how every existing grade is labeled, not just new ones.
grading.confirmBody: This changes how every existing grade at this school is displayed — from {{from}} to {{to}}. It takes effect immediately across every report card and gradebook.

invitationExpiry.description: How long a new invitation link stays valid before it expires.
invitationExpiry.label: Expires after (days)
invitationExpiry.help: Applies to invitations sent after this change — already-sent links keep their original expiry.

attendance.title: Attendance alerts
attendance.description: Thresholds that trigger attendance alerts, the teacher correction window, and discipline visibility for parents.
attendance.attendanceThresholdHelp: An alert fires when a student's attendance rate falls below this percentage.
attendance.absenceThresholdHelp: An alert fires when a student's absence rate rises above this percentage.
attendance.correctionWindowHelp: How long after a session teachers can still correct its attendance. After it, only a principal can.
attendance.parentVisibility: Parents can view their child's resolved discipline incidents
attendance.showBody: Every parent at this school will immediately be able to see their own child's resolved discipline incidents in the portal.
attendance.hideBody: Parents will immediately lose access to their child's resolved discipline incidents in the portal.
